## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; confirmations: narrow sector wins (Energy/Utilities/Industrials) while mega-cap tech shows major divergence (multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches). Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 across 3 sectors). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.74% | 1M: +10.48%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +7.36% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND.  
Utilities strong: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Consumer Discretionary weak: TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -6.70% | 1M: +0.08%) CORRECTION. Communication weak: CMCSA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -11.63% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND. Technology soft overall with pockets of strength: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND, HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +8.44% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: META (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION, CMCSA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -9.12% | 1M: +2.29%) CORRECTION, ADBE (1W: -9.83% | 1M: +7.47%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Tech/Comm.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: VST (1W: +10.76%), LMT (1W: +10.72%), CEG (1W: +9.46%), HON (1W: +8.81%), AMD (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND; note major divergence among large-cap tech names (multiple CORRECTION/BELOW TREND prints) — tactical risk.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Technology mixed to weak: NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier while GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION and MSFT (1W: -4.87% | 1M: +2.04%) CORRECTION show exhaustion — sector 1W performance negative overall.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials uneven: JPM (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND shows resilience while V (1W: -3.71% | 1M: +7.04%) CORRECTION and MA (1W: -3.85% | 1M: +8.83%) CORRECTION signal dispersion; sector 1W is modestly negative.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare mixed with defensive names holding: JNJ (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +8.44%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +7.12%) ABOVE TREND but bearish headlines present — watch divergence between news and price.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure to Energy/Utilities/Industrials where leadership is clear and stocks show ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to names showing CORRECTION/BELOW TREND in Tech and Communication. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; be selective given major mega-cap divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -17.65%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.06%) and Utilities (1W: +2.71%) with clear momentum.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -3.49%), Communication (1W: -4.40%), Consumer Discretionary (1W: -4.53%) where downside is concentrated.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (watch confirmation above recent high for continuation; NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND).  
AAPL (watch support near last month's low; AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION).  
JPM (watch breakout continuation above recent resistance; JPM (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND).  
XOM (watch hold above recent support for further energy strength; XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
BA (+75): FAA win headlines; BA (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -3.45%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price.  
WMT (+80): headline-driven buyback criticism; WMT (1W: -5.70% | 1M: -9.23%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price.  
CRM (+60): $1.6B VA deal; CRM (1W: -9.12% | 1M: +2.29%) CORRECTION — bullish news but short-term price weakness.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
LLY (-45): Goldman caution; LLY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +7.12%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging vs price.  
JPM (-45): governance headline; JPM (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment/price divergence.  
IBM (-60): hardware spending concerns; IBM not in detailed view so monitor separately (no 1W/1M in this brief).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership.  
Energy and select Industrials showing relative strength (XOM ABOVE TREND, LMT ABOVE TREND, VST ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk: major divergence among mega-cap tech (multiple CORRECTION/BELOW TREND names) and several high-profile stocks with news/price mismatch — watch for trend confirmation.
